subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: After the security hardening is applied, should OpenClaw own this unsigned iOS archive workflow as core CI infrastructure?
rationale: The mechanical defects are fixable, but the PR still creates a new macOS artifact-producing workflow and unsigned archive distribution path that maintainers must intentionally own.

options.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
options.body: Fix the shell input handling, token permissions, checkout credentials, action pins, and rerun proof before deciding the workflow is mergeable.

options.title: Keep It External For Now
options.body: Leave the fork workflow as contributor proof and do not add a new core CI artifact lane until iOS distribution policy is clearer.

options.title: Fold Into Existing iOS CI
options.body: Replace the standalone workflow with a maintainer-designed extension of the existing iOS build/release lanes.

recommendation.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
recommendation.body: Fix the shell input handling, token permissions, checkout credentials, action pins, and rerun proof before deciding the workflow is mergeable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI and iOS history makes this the strongest available routing owner for the final infra acceptance call.
